content:
Alex: Quick check — for the newsletter relaunch next week, I'm proposing an "opt-out velocity" nudge sequence for low-engagement cohorts. Short version: 3 nudges over 10 days, then move to suppressed. Thoughts?

Priya: +1 conceptually. Want the exact cadence though. Are we doing 24h/72h/10d or stretched out? Also need copy variants for EU vs NA.

Alex: Thinking timing by last-open date bucket: <30d = soft nudge at 48h; 30-90d = 72h, 7 days, final 10 days; >90d = immediate re-engage + suppression if no click. Keep subject lines short.

Marco: Can we route anyone who clicks the re-engage to the sales cadence if they also have >3 product page visits in 7d? We don't want to miss inbound intent.

Sasha: Agreed. Add a tag in CRM: newsletter_reengage_click + intent_high. We'll surface in the daily leads dashboard. I'll add to the zap.

Priya: Copy ideas (short):
- Variant A: "We miss you — quick update from Redwood Inference"
- Variant B: "Is Redwood still useful for you? 1-min update"
- Variant C (EU): "Your account & updates — a quick note"
Which to A/B first?

Alex: A/B A vs B on subject open rate. If open > baseline +4ppt, use winner for subsequent sends. C only for EU because of privacy phrasing.

Marco: Deliverability note — keep initial send to 8% of list as canary across IP pools, then ramp to 40% in 6 hours, 100% next day. Use region-aware send windows: NA 10–2 PT, EMEA 10–2 CET, APAC 10–2 SGT.

deliverability-bot: Bounce summary last 30d: hard_bounces=0.4%, soft_bounces=1.2%, complaint_rate=0.02%. Suggested: suppress domains with >5 bounces and mute older MX blacklists.

Priya: Good call on canary. Also want to run small creative test: CTA as "See benchmarks" vs "Quick product tour" — route clicks to different landing pages for funnel differences. Track via utm_campaign=relauch_opt_vel and utm_content=ctaA/ctaB.

Alex: For segmentation SQL (Marco / Data team confirm):
```sql
SELECT user_id, email, last_open_at, region, product_page_views_7d
FROM newsletter_users
WHERE subscribed = true
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND (last_open_at IS NULL OR last_open_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_list)
```
Will generate cohorts: 0-30d, 30-90d, 90+d.

Marco: I'll validate and add the product_page_views join for intent. Also will export canary cohort IDs to a staging list for the ESP.

Sasha: Workflow for Sales routing: webhook to /integrations/sales/new-lead when tag added. Sales playbook will be "reengage_inbound". Priya please confirm copy for the lead note.

Priya: Lead note: "Clicked re-engage email + high product activity — suggest quick intro + walkthrough. Saw pages: {{top_pages}}"

Marco: Quick QA checklist before send: 1) links resolve 2) UTM params present 3) ESP throttling set 4) suppression imports fresh 5) test sends to inboxes for each region + major providers.

Alex: I'll own checklist and final send approvals. Timeline: canary Monday 10am PT, ramp Tue 10am PT, full send Wed (if canary healthy).

Sasha: I'll wire the webhook and CRM tag today.

deliverability-bot: Note: avoid >3 sends in 7 days to same cohort, or complaint rate increases historically.

Priya: Ok I'll prepare the two subject variants + two CTA landing pages and send preview screenshots here by EOD.

Alex: Perfect. If nothing else, we'll lock cadence and canary list by EOD. Thanks team :rocket:
